question: **Choose the incorrectly spelt word.**
solution:
The incorrectly spelt word is: **Temparory**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of the word is "**Temporary**". (अस्थायी)
 
• The mistake in this word is the missing "**o**".
 
• The correct spelling follows the rule of adding "**-ary**" at the end of "**tempor**" to form an adjective.
 
• Other examples of words that follow this rule are "contemporary", "preliminary", and "supplementary".

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4** which is incorrectly spelt.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: "**Molest**" means to harass or assault someone sexually or physically. (किसी को यौन या शारीरिक रूप से परेशान करना या हमला करना)
 
• Option 2: "**Reflect**" means to bounce back or mirror an image or thought. (किसी छवि या विचार को वापस उछालना या प्रतिबिंबित करना)
 
• Option 3: "**Called**" is the past tense of "call", which means to give a name or make a request. (एक नाम देना या अनुरोध करना)
